verses.text: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

segments.text: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

verses.text: Suffer me a little, and I will show thee; For I have yet somewhat to say on God’s behalf.

segments.text: Suffer me a little, and I will show thee;

verses.text: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, And will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

verses.text: For truly my words are not false: One that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

verses.text: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: He is mighty in strength of understanding.

verses.text: He preserveth not the life of the wicked, But giveth to the afflicted their right.

verses.text: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: But with kings upon the throne He setteth them for ever, and they are exalted.

verses.text: And if they be bound in fetters, And be taken in the cords of affliction;

verses.text: Then he showeth them their work, And their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

verses.text: He openeth also their ear to instruction, And commandeth that they return from iniquity.

verses.text: If they hearken and serve him, They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.

verses.text: But if they hearken not, they shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.

verses.text: But they that are godless in heart lay up anger: They cry not for help when he bindeth them.

verses.text: Yea, he would have allured thee out of distress Into a broad place, where there is no straitness; And that which is set on thy table would be full of fatness.

verses.text: For let not wrath stir thee up against chastisements; Neither let the greatness of the ransom turn thee aside.

verses.text: Behold, God doeth loftily in his power: Who is a teacher like unto him?

verses.text: Who hath enjoined him his way? Or who can say, Thou hast wrought unrighteousness?
